searchText: Hey folks, it looks like we have consensus in merging https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3095 ? We have already implemented this change in Teku (sitting as a PR, haven't merged it yet to keep Teku nodes in the testnet healthy). What's the status from other teams? we (Lighthouse) don't have it implemented yet but are supportive and could get it done for the next devnet I have the PR out as of today, but I can't merge it cause it breaks spectests I would rather not test on devnet until testvectors are up
